title: ～のは Noun ぐらいのものだ
romaji: 〜no wa Noun gurai no mono da
shortExplanation: Conveys that 'only (Noun) is the case' or 'nothing but (Noun)'.
longExplanation: The ～のは Noun ぐらいのものだ pattern indicates that something is exclusively or solely that particular Noun, conveying the sense of 'That's the only thing...' or 'There's nothing but...' about a situation.
formation: Verb-casual + のは + Noun + ぐらいのものだ, い-Adjective + のは + Noun + ぐらいのものだ, etc.

examples.jp: この小説を読むのは暇つぶしぐらいのものだ。
examples.romaji: Kono shousetsu o yomu no wa hima tsubushi gurai no mono da.
examples.en: Reading this novel is nothing but a way to kill time.

examples.jp: 今日の夕食で良かったのはピザぐらいのものだ。
examples.romaji: Kyou no yuushoku de yokatta no wa piza gurai no mono da.
examples.en: About the only good thing at tonight's dinner was the pizza.

examples.jp: この映画を見るのは時間の無駄ぐらいのものだ。
examples.romaji: Kono eiga o miru no wa jikan no muda gurai no mono da.
examples.en: Watching this movie is nothing but a waste of time.

examples.jp: 彼と話すのはストレスぐらいのものだ。
examples.romaji: Kare to hanasu no wa sutoresu gurai no mono da.
examples.en: Talking to him is nothing but stressful.
